snippet.title: The GOAT is Messi
snippet.description:
In 2012, Lionel Messi scored 91 goals in a single calendar year for club and country — the most ever in football history.

That record broke a 40-year-old milestone set by Gerd Müller, who had 85 goals in 1972.

Pretty insane when you think about consistency over an entire year.
